decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( 14-136-17,14-136-18,14-136-19 Rev A, 14-136-20,14-136-21 Rev A, 14-136-70, 675/M101 Rev T1, 71 Rev T1, AHU Design Technical Specification  AHU.1,  AHU Design Technical Specification  AHU.2, BlueBox Epsilon Echos  Specification, Design and Access Statement Received: 24 August 2017 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The rating level of noise emitted from fixed plant on the site, shall be lower than the existing background noise level by 10dB. The noise levels shall be determined at the nearest noise sensitive locations. The measurements shall be made according to BS4142:2014.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place before details of the external finish of the enclosures and flue hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Installation of external AC units and ducts
